poster.description:
In the sacred storytelling tradition of South Indian Shaivism, the Siva Puranam unfolds as a vast tapestry of devotion, cosmic drama, and divine mystery. From the silent peaks of Kailasa to the ritual fires of ancient kingdoms, these stories reveal Shiva not only as the fierce destroyer of illusion, but as the compassionate heart of the universe.

The narrative moves through some of the most beloved episodes of the Shaivite tradition. Sati’s tragic defiance and self‑sacrifice ignites a chain of events that shakes heaven and earth, leading to the terrible wrath of Shiva and the fall of Daksha’s pride. In time, Sati returns as Parvati, the mountain princess whose unwavering penance and fearless devotion win the love of the ascetic god. Their divine wedding becomes a cosmic celebration, binding heaven, earth, and the elements in sacred union.

Life on Mount Kailasa reveals Shiva and Parvati not only as cosmic powers but as a divine household whose love shapes the destiny of the worlds. From their union emerges Skanda, the radiant warrior destined to defeat the demon Taraka, while Parvati’s clay guardian becomes the beloved elephant‑headed Ganapati, lord of beginnings and remover of obstacles. Around them swirl sages, gods, demons, and celestial beings, each drawn into Shiva’s mysterious play.

Blending philosophy, devotion, myth, and wonder, the Siva Puranam presents a vision of the universe where love, penance, and humility carry the power to reshape destiny itself. Rich with sacred symbolism and timeless storytelling, these episodes invite readers into the living devotional imagination of the Hindu world—where every act, every trial, and every triumph ultimately leads back to the infinite presence of Shiva.
poster.cover_scene: In a South Indian temple‑mural style, Shiva and Parvati enthroned upon Mount Kailasa at the center of a cosmic mandala—surrounded by Ganesha, Skanda, sages, gods, and swirling celestial beings—rendered in terracotta reds, indigo, malachite green, and gold like an ancient fresco come to life.

title: Siva Puranam
